title: Post-Judgment Remedies Authorized under the Legal Forwarding Agreements Programmes
content:
**For network attorneys.** The remedies a collection attorney may pursue after judgment on a matter forwarded under the Legal Forwarding Agreements depend on the client's forwarding programme. This table states, for each programme, whether it enforces judgments, the calendar days after judgment before enforcement is filed, and which of the three remedies — wage garnishment, bank levy and judgment lien on real property — it authorizes.

## Remedies table

| Programme | Enforces judgments | Days after judgment before enforcement is filed | Wage garnishment | Bank levy | Judgment lien on real property |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Attorney Demand Program | No | 0 | No | No | No |
| Small Claims Suit Program | Yes | 30 | Yes | No | No |
| Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | No |
| Judgment Enforcement Program | Yes | 14 | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Full-Service Litigation Program | Yes | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Scope of each entry

- **Enforces judgments** — whether the programme enforces judgments at all. The Attorney Demand Program does not; every other programme does.
- **Days after judgment** — the calendar days after judgment before enforcement is filed: 14 under the Judgment Enforcement Program, 30 under the other enforcing programmes, and 0 under the Attorney Demand Program, which enforces none.
- **Wage garnishment** — whether wage garnishment may be sought where state law permits.
- **Bank levy** — whether a bank levy may be sought where state law permits.
- **Judgment lien on real property** — whether a judgment lien on real property may be recorded.

## The remedies grouped

| Remedies authorized | Programmes |
|---|---|
| Wage garnishment, bank levy and property lien | Client-Advanced Cost Suit Program, Judgment Enforcement Program, Full-Service Litigation Program |
| Wage garnishment and bank levy, no property lien | Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program |
| Wage garnishment only | Small Claims Suit Program |
| None | Attorney Demand Program |

## Sample questions, answered from the table

*May a bank levy be sought on a Small Claims Suit Program matter?* No — that programme shows No for bank levy.

*May a property lien be recorded on an Agency-Advanced Cost Suit Program matter?* No — that programme authorizes garnishment and levy but not a judgment lien on real property.

*How long after judgment is enforcement filed under the Judgment Enforcement Program?* After 14 calendar days.
